title: Its not what it use to be…

Hundreds of letterd, buttons, flying things, new apps apearing, voices, too diff too even get to the actual habit check off and when you do it open another window with timers foe each habit abd i just want to check then off 🥲😒 Idk, for a person who has adhd this is so distracting it would be way way better if it was somehow linear and not so open world like ( of you get the gaming refrance ). If there is like a line with no distractions and every checkpoint has like a lesson even with a questionnare or smth so it really teached you smth like atomic habits with quzies on each level but checking off staying as simple as possible. But yeah just dont have the motivation i used to have when i started this app years ago.

title: Horrible UX and Subscription flows
body: One of the worst applications I have ever used in terms of how to subscribe, app not backing up your data by default so you end up losing progress, customer support being useless, you sign up for this app, and get access to 6 more apps that you absolutely don’t want or need but your data is shared amongst all these apps. Some things you can only manage via mobile app, and some thing only via web. Pure horror of an “app”.

title: 1 star - Scammy Billing Practices
body:
I signed up for a free trial, canceled it before it ended, and still got charged $39.99 nearly three months later. After reaching out to support, they refused to issue a refund, despite many other users reporting the same issue.

This app uses deceptive billing practices, making it difficult to cancel and charging users unexpectedly. Avoid this app unless you want surprise charges! I’ve reported it to Apple and suggest others do the same.
